propositions: test_perf asserts a fixed 50ms wall-clock budget on a single run of rebar.llm.overlap.retrieve() over 300 digests, causing intermittent CI failures under runner contention.
The function's true cost is ~1.6ms median with ~30x margin to budget, but transient scheduler contention inflates individual samples to 180x+ the uncontended cost.

Single-sample wall-clock measurements are not robust to shared-runner CPU scheduling; the test must measure best-of-N (minimum across ≥5 runs) to distinguish transient contention from algorithmic regression.
A best-of-N approach retains performance guardrail teeth: sustained slowdowns fail every sample including the minimum, but transient stalls only affect individual samples.
